contract: Each namespace has its own custom search attribute registry. The unchanged published SDK lists, registers and removes definitions: a new namespace lists the eleven system attributes and renders an empty custom map as a JSON array. Request strings are trimmed before validation. Laravel validation refuses missing, non-string, malformed, over-long and unknown-type fields with 422 validation_failed and the published messages and error counts. A duplicate name is refused with 409 attribute_already_exists and keeps its original type; system names and their snake_case aliases, in any case, are refused with 409 name_reserved. A system attribute cannot be removed (409 system_attribute) and an absent one is 404 attribute_not_found. A namespace accepts 100 definitions and refuses the next with 422 search_attribute_limit_reached without storing it. Search attribute values on start and upsert, and visibility filters on them, need separate fixtures. Embedded applications have no HTTP registry.
